=== SCENARIO DEFINITIONS & TEMPLATE FOR ROW BOAT PUZZLES ===
To add a new scenario, create an entry with a unique key. Each scenario requires:
- title (string): Displayed in the tab.
- capacity (number): Maximum seats on the row boat.
- characters (array): Items or people crossing the river. Each has:
    id: unique identifier (string)
    name: full display name (string)
    abbr: short 1-3 letter badge (e.g. 'F', 'W', 'M1')
    type: 'human' | 'animal' | 'object'
    emoji: icon character
    canRow: boolean (true if can steer the boat)
    ownerOf (optional): id of animal owned
    ownedBy (optional): id of owner human
- rulesText (array of strings): Displayed in the Rules panel.
- conflicts (array of conflict objects evaluated on unattended banks):
    predatorId: character id acting out
    victimId: character id attacked or eaten
    protectorId: character id whose presence prevents the attack
    message: failure description
    or ownerAbsent (boolean): if true, predator attacks victim unless predator's ownedBy is on the bank.

_template_example.title: Example Scenario
rulesText: Monster (M) crushes Treasure (T) if left without Rower (R).

mwgc.title: 1. Wolf, Goat & Cabbage
rulesText: Wolf (W) eats Goat (G) if left together without Farmer (F).
Goat (G) eats Cabbage (C) if left together without Farmer (F).
Farmer (F) must be in the boat to row it.

3m3d.title: 2. Three Men & Three Dogs
rulesText: Dogs (D1, D2, D3) bite other men if their owner is absent.
Dogs are completely friendly with each other.
Boat has 3 seats and requires at least one Man to maneuver.

conflicts.message: A dog bit someone because their owner wasn't there!
Cat (C) harmed Fish (F) because Alice (A) was missing!
